text:
The dish looks like a white paper plate about 18-20 cm across. It holds diced cooked chicken breast, roughly 25-30 pieces of about 2 cm each.

Each piece is about 2×2×1 cm, or roughly 4 cm³, which is about 4 g. Thirty pieces would then weigh about 120 g, and the loose pile could be as much as 150 g, so I'll estimate about 120 g.

Cooked chicken breast with some seasoning or sauce runs about 1.6-1.8 kcal/g, so 120 g comes to about 200 kcal.
